files.README.md:
# Subscription ledger export, 2026-09-01

The billing system mixes conventions: most rows use YYYY-MM-DD, three legacy rows use DD/MM/YYYY (slash dates read day/month/year). A subscription is active in a month when its period covers at least one day of that month; an empty end_date means still renewing. The status column is the snapshot flag at export time.

turns.prompt: Our subscription ledger is in subs-export.csv. How many subscriptions were active in August 2026? Answer with the number alone.
What was the combined MRR of those August-active subscriptions? Answer with the number alone, two decimals.
Change of plan — I need July 2026 instead. How many subscriptions were active that month? Answer with the number alone.
Of the July-active ones, how many are on the growth plan? Answer with the number alone.
